content: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) package imports: Use npm: specifier (e.g. 'npm:@anthropic-ai/sdk@0.105.0') — Supabase recommended as of 2025 over esm.sh CDN. Each function has its own deno.json import map. Alternatively use raw fetch against api.anthropic.com/v1/messages with x-api-key and anthropic-version headers. The raw-fetch approach has zero import overhead and avoids any ESM compatibility issues but sacrifices type safety. Existing pattern in codebase: all other EFs use esm.sh for @supabase/supabase-js@2 — acceptable to keep esm.sh for Supabase client but prefer npm: for Anthropic SDK.
